playbookOutputs: EMP501 reconciliation (EMP201 declarations vs payments vs IRP5/IT3(a) certificates)
EMP501 submitted via eFiling or e@syFile
playbookCommonFailures: Certificates total does not equal EMP201 declarations total, so the recon fails validation
Payments on the SARS statement of account differ from declarations (unallocated or late payments)
Employees without tax reference numbers — certificates rejected
Employer has more employees than eFiling allows so e@syFile is required, and the e@syFile database is not set up
Interim (August) recon filed as if it were the annual (February) recon

informationToProvide.label: Company Name
informationToProvide.aiHint: Registered company name as on the SARS profile with the PAYE reference number.

informationToProvide.label: Access to your SARS eFiling profile
Payroll reports for the entire tax year
informationToProvide.aiHint: Year-to-date payroll report per employee (March–February, or March–August for the interim recon) with gross pay by source code, PAYE, UIF, SDL. If payroll is in AI Payroll, pull from there.

informationToProvide.label: Monthly EMP201 submission records for the tax year
informationToProvide.aiHint: Each month's filed EMP201 and proof of payment; alternatively the eFiling PAYE statement of account for the period. Needed to reconcile declared vs paid.

informationToProvide.label: Employee details including ID numbers, tax numbers, and remuneration data
informationToProvide.aiHint: Employee master list: full names, ID/passport numbers, income tax reference numbers, dates of employment, residential address, bank details. Every certificate needs these; flag missing tax numbers early (SARS can register employees via the ITREG function on e@syFile).

informationToProvide.label: Confirmation of all IRP5/IT3(a) data issued

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access, payroll year data and EMP201 records
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Payroll year report, employee master data, EMP201 records / statement of account and credentials on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Confirm whether this is the interim (Mar–Aug) or annual (Mar–Feb) reconciliation. Ask for the employee master list with tax numbers first — it is the usual blocker. Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify employee data and EMP201 completeness
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Every employee has ID and tax number; every month in the period has a filed EMP201 and payment on the statement of account
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: List employees missing tax numbers; list months where the EMP201 is missing or unpaid (raise a proposal — those must be fixed before the recon). Confirm whether the employer must use e@syFile (⚠ verify current eFiling employee limit) or can file on eFiling.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reconcile PAYE/UIF/SDL and generate certificates
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificates total = EMP201 declarations total = payments; differences explained; Kevin has reviewed
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Pull the EMP501 reconciliation and IRP5/IT3(a) data from AI Payroll. Reconcile per month: declared (EMP201) vs paid (statement of account) vs certificates. Differences must be resolved by correcting EMP201s (request for correction) or explained — Kevin decides. ETI reconciliation if claimed.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft payroll computation and EMP501 handoff sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet shows monthly liabilities, payments, certificate totals and the e@syFile/eFiling route
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Include the certificate list (employee, certificate type IRP5 vs IT3(a), total remuneration, PAYE) and any employee missing data.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit the EMP501 and certificates on eFiling / e@syFile
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: EMP501 accepted (status Submitted, no validation errors) and certificates generated
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Returns → EMP501 → reconciliation period (eFiling) or e@syFile Employer with the CSV import from payroll. Enter monthly liabilities and payments, load certificates, run the validation until it balances. Agent drives to the summary; Kevin reviews and presses Submit. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin. e@syFile submissions are done on Kevin's machine in hand-off mode.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver confirmation and IRP5/IT3(a) certificates
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Confirmation and the certificate PDFs posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Send the certificates and explain plainly that each employee needs their IRP5/IT3(a) for their own ITR12 (also visible on their eFiling once SARS processes the recon). Note any months corrected.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
